reading.body:
Meta operates a data center campus in Fort Worth, Tarrant County, Texas, located at Alliance Gateway Freeway. The facility's power capacity is not published. Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities across the state, of which 18 operators have published power specifications totaling 468 megawatts. This campus would rank 19th by published capacity in Texas if its power draw were disclosed, suggesting the operator has chosen not to release the specification.

Research on the specific facility's opening date, investment, and building details was not successful. Meta's company-level disclosures indicate the operator runs a fleet of at least 21 data centers globally and has announced a separate 10-billion-dollar investment in an AI data center in northeast Louisiana, but site-specific information for the Fort Worth location does not appear in available sources. The research budget for this location is exhausted.

Without published power specifications, the Fort Worth campus cannot be assessed against the threshold question of whether it matters to AI scaling. The facility's relevance to grid constraint analysis, compute density, or AI training capacity depends on data the operator has not released.
